task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate the CAR robot close to the CUP, pick it up, navigate close to the TABLE, and place the CUP on it.
assumptions: The CAR robot can successfully navigate to coordinates within interaction distance of the CUP and TABLE.
The CUP is graspable and the TABLE is a valid placement target.
The Pick and Place skills will succeed when preconditions (proximity, not holding/holding) are met.
